title: YieldLag: Seasonal Climate Responses and Regional Crop Yield Modelling

creators.name: Eini, Mohammad Reza
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering and Architecture, Warsaw University of Life Sciences - SGGW

description: YieldLag is an R package for regional statistical climate-yield modelling, chronological model comparison, separate interval calibration, seasonal nonlinear responses, prediction decomposition, and paired year-block uncertainty analysis. The software is MIT licensed. Bundled Poland example data retain the source attribution and separate terms in inst/extdata/poland/DATA_LICENSE.md; the MIT license does not apply to provider data. The Poland examples are retrospective benchmarks and do not establish operational forecast skill, causal effects, or universal model superiority.
